text:
Camila Santos: Heads-up — Redwood trial cluster question from Meridian Health. They want a single RFI row that explains POC runbook: capacity targets, fallback options, billing impact, and the one-line procurement-safe clause. Can we sketch?

Omar Diaz: Sure. I'd add a compact row titled 'POC Runbook & Fallback'. Columns: Default behavior, Fallback options, Latency expectation (p99), Billing note, Exit & audit. Keep numbers conservative.

Helena Park: For their 25 qps chat profile (avg seq ~200 tokens) callouts: Dedicated baseline p99 ~210ms, controlled fallback to hosted ~310-350ms depending on region. Put p99 ranges not exact numbers.

Camila Santos: Procurement wants a worst-case monthly delta cell. BillingBot, can you give a short estimate for: Dedicated reserved 2x mid-GPU, with 15% overflow to hosted steady over month, and a spike scenario of 48 hours at 60% overflow?

BillingBot: Baseline POC cost (Dedicated 2x mid-GPU reserved): $15,200/mo. Typical overflow (15% steady) adds ~ $2,700/mo (+18%). Spike scenario (48h at 60% overflow) incremental cost ~ $6,500 for that month; report worst-case delta as '+$6.5k (+43%)' for budgeting. Assumptions: token mix avg 200 tok/session, hosted unit rates apply to overflow.

Omar Diaz: Add a short sentence about data residency: "Fallback is disabled by policy for accounts with data-residency flags; otherwise controlled fallback is opt-in and region-restricted."

Helena Park: Security asked for audit retention phrasing. SecOps Bot, what can we commit in RFI?

SecOps Bot: Suggested RFI text: "Fallback enable/disable, user, timestamp, and reason are logged and retained for 540 days; audit logs are exportable to customer SIEM via syslog/S3 forwarders (per subscription tier)."

Camila Santos: Legal needs a procurement-safe one-liner about liability for cross-region processing when fallback is enabled. contract-bot?

contract-bot: Draft: "When the Customer elects to enable Controlled Fallback, processing may occur in Redwood-managed regions as specified in the addendum; Redwood's liability for cross-region transfer is limited when fallback is enabled by Customer in writing."

Omar Diaz: Perfect. Also include a tiny API example for the RFI appendix so their infra team can sanity-check operations. Keep it short.

Helena Park: Example below (use YAML in appendix).

Helena Park: ```yaml
routing:
  project: meridian-poc
  primary: dedicated-meridian
  fallback: hosted-lowlatency
  conditions:
    - queue_utilization > 0.8
    - p99_observed > 260ms
  region_controls:
    - allowed_regions: [us-east-1, us-west-2]
    - fallback_opt_in: true
  drain_seconds: 300
```

Camila Santos: Good. Procurement also requested a line about billing caps and who to contact to enable them. BillingBot?

BillingBot: Add: "POC billing caps available; default template cap $25k/mo. To adjust, request via your sales contact or billing@redwood.ai."

Omar Diaz: We're missing network attachments. Helena, can you drop a redacted diagram and SOC excerpt into the package and link them in the RFI bundle?

Helena Park: Uploaded redacted SOC excerpt and network sketch: https://files.redwood.internal/sales/meridian/soc_redacted.pdf and https://files.redwood.internal/sales/meridian/network_sketch_redacted.png :paperclip:

Camila Santos: Nice. One last procurement ask: a single-cell that says whether fallback requires a signed addendum for accounts with residency needs. Put short: 'Yes — addendum required when data-residency flag set.'

contract-bot: Confirming phrasing OK. Also recommend adding: 'Activation via console/API requires MFA and recorded justification.'

Camila Santos: I'll fold these into the capability matrix rows: Feature, Default, Fallback, p99 range, Billing typical delta, Billing worst-case delta, Audit retention, Addendum required. Then I'll ping legal for sign-off and send the bundle.

Omar Diaz: Quick note for the RFI matrix text: "Dedicated primary with optional Controlled Fallback (opt-in). Fallback is region-limited, auditable, and subject to billing at hosted overflow rates; disabled for accounts flagged for zero-egress."

Helena Park: Sent the draft to legal and procurement for review. Meeting with Meridian scheduled tomorrow 09:30 PT to walk through.

Camila Santos: Thanks team — will update after legal sign-off. :white_check_mark:
